evidence: Experimental: pristine and Pt/Sn-doped HfCoSb synthesised and Seebeck/resistivity measured; parent of the widely studied p-type (Hf,Zr,Ti)CoSb(Sn) half-Heusler family.
notes: Pristine HfCoSb is semimetal-like with small S; high performance only after doping/alloying, but the family is canonical.

evidence: Experimental: phase-pure/directionally solidified NbCoSn synthesised with measured Seebeck, resistivity and PF; Pt-substituted n-type NbCoSn with measured zT.
notes: Recognised n-type half-Heusler TE (also p-type Sc-doped and Ta-alloyed variants reported).

evidence: Experimental: pristine TiCoSb and (Ti,Zr,Hf)CoSb compounds synthesised with measured resistivity, Seebeck and thermal conductivity; long-standing p/n-type half-Heusler TE family.
notes: Crossref issue date 2000 (print vol. 13, 2001).

evidence: Experimental: p-type ZrCoBi-based half-Heuslers synthesised with measured zT and device conversion efficiency.
notes: Record values are for doped/alloyed ZrCoBi(Sb,Sn); family is widely recognised.

evidence: Experimental: pristine and doped ZrCoSb synthesised with measured Seebeck/resistivity; core member of p-type MCoSb half-Heusler family.
Experimental: p-type NbFeSb-based half-Heuslers (Ti/Hf/Zr-doped) synthesised with measured zT > 1; widely recognised TE family.
notes: Pristine NbFeSb also measured (Young 2000, J. Appl. Phys. 87, 317; doi 10.1063/1.371863).

evidence: Experimental: TaFeSb-based half-Heuslers (Ti-substituted Ta1-xTixFeSb) synthesised by inverse design with measured high zT; also highlighted computationally.
notes: Measured performance is for Ti-substituted samples; ESTABLISHED as a recognised TE family rather than pristine-composition data.

evidence: Experimental: pristine and doped FeVSb synthesised and Seebeck/resistivity/thermal conductivity measured in several independent studies; p-type FeVSb-based alloys are a recognised HH TE family.
notes: Further experimental work: Jodin et al. PRB 70, 184207 (2004), doi 10.1103/physrevb.70.184207 (verified); Fu et al. JAP 114, 134905 (2013) on FeV0.6Nb0.4Sb.

evidence: Experimental: canonical n-type MNiSn HH thermoelectric; pristine and Sb-doped TiNiSn synthesised and S/PF/zT measured in many studies.
notes: A widely recognised TE family member; large literature.

evidence: Experimental: canonical n-type HH thermoelectric; pristine and doped ZrNiSn synthesised and S/PF/zT measured extensively.
source_2: Hohl 1999, Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter 11, 1697-1709
notes: A widely recognised TE family member; large literature.

evidence: Experimental: half-Heusler TaCoSn first synthesised and TE properties measured for pristine and Nb/Sb-alloyed n-type samples (zT reported); earlier computational prediction.
notes: Borderline ESTABLISHED/PRIOR: experimental TE evidence rests mainly on one group (Li/Zhu/Zhang 2019).

evidence: One experimental study (powder metallurgy + SPS) gave multiphase non-stoichiometric CoVSn with measured, very low zT; preceded by computational prediction of high p-type performance.
notes: Sample contained SnV3, Co2Sn, Co3V impurities; phase-pure half-Heusler CoVSn not demonstrated. Also Zeeshan 2017 PRM (computational).

evidence: Experimental but limited: L2_1 Fe2TiSi realised only as epitaxial thin films (sputtering, MBE); one film study measured room-temperature Seebeck and thermal conductivity; computational TE prediction (Bilc 2015).
notes: Borderline ESTABLISHED/PRIOR. Bulk L2_1 Fe2TiSi reported metastable (competes with Fe2Ti C14 Laves phase). Crossref title says "D3-type" (D0_3 in paper).

evidence: Half-Heusler NbIrSn synthesised; room-temperature Seebeck coefficient and resistivity measured. Computational only: dedicated first-principles TE study (electron and phonon transport, zT) of pristine HH NbIrSn; also included in a high-throughput PF/zT screen.
notes: Half-Heusler NbIrSn was synthesised and its room-temperature Seebeck coefficient (+176 uV/K) and resistivity measured (Hohl 1998, abstract read). Same computational group followed up with a strain study: Khatri et al. Physica B 724, 418159 (2026), doi 10.1016/j.physb.2025.418159.

evidence: Experimental: pristine ScNiSb synthesised and S, rho, kappa, zT measured in several independent studies; doped variants also measured.
source_2: Oestreich 2003, Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter 15, 635-640
notes: Also Ciesielski et al. IJMPB 38, 2450084 (2023/24), doi 10.1142/s021797922450084x (verified). Computational: Winiarski et al. J. Alloys Compd. 762, 901 (2018).

evidence: One dedicated experimental study (synthesis and measured S, sigma, kappa of pristine YNiBi), plus several ab initio PF studies.
notes: Borderline ESTABLISHED: there is a credible experimental TE paper, but only one dedicated study was found. Computational: Sharma & Kumar MRX 5, 046528 (2018), doi 10.1088/2053-1591/aabbf1.

evidence: Experimental thermopower/transport of pristine YNiSb measured in a comparative ScMSb/YMSb study; ab initio work predicts a high p-type PF.
source_1: Oestreich 2003, Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter 15, 635-640
notes: Borderline ESTABLISHED: the experimental evidence is limited to a small number of older studies (also magnetotransport, Karla 1998 JALCOM 265, 42). No modern zT optimisation found.

evidence: Experimental: pristine polycrystalline ScPdSb was synthesised and its thermoelectric properties (Seebeck, resistivity, ZT near 300 K) measured in one study; later a DFT+BoltzTraP study computed p-type transport.
notes: Borderline ESTABLISHED/PRIOR: only one experimental TE study (2003, small ZT); Winiarski 2018 calls experimental data 'very limited'. Synthesis/defect chemistry also in Harmening 2009, Solid State Sci. 11, 900 (10.1016/j.solidstatesciences.2008.12.007, Crossref-verified).

evidence: Experimental: pristine polycrystalline ScPtSb was synthesised and thermoelectric properties measured (one study, small ZT near 300 K); later DFT+BoltzTraP predicted it to have the largest p-type power factor of ScMSb.
notes: Borderline ESTABLISHED/PRIOR: single experimental TE study (2003); further DFT work on structure/optics under pressure exists. Synthesis/defects also in Harmening 2009, Solid State Sci. 11, 900 (10.1016/j.solidstatesciences.2008.12.007, Crossref-verified).

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. Computational only: listed among AFLOW thermodynamically stable half-Heuslers with a high-throughput lattice-thermal-conductivity estimate and in an ML/DFT kappa_L dataset; no dedicated TE transport study, synthesis or measurement found.
notes: Appears as "AuAlHf" in Carrete Table III and "AlAuHf" in Tranas tables (checked in full text). Absence of experimental reports is not proof of absence.

evidence: Dedicated DFT thermoelectric study; also in high-throughput screens. Computational screening only: kappa_L estimate in AFLOW-based high-throughput screen and an n-type conductivity-effective-mass descriptor in a 69-compound half-Heusler band-engineering table; no dedicated TE study or measurement found.
notes: Listed as "CoAsHf" in Carrete Table III (checked). Orthorhombic Co2Si-type (Pnma) structure determined by Kleinke and Franzen from single-crystal data, as stated by Makara and Zhak 2018 (Chemical Problems of Today, p. 101, read in full) and by ICSD 406953 (Pnma, oP12) in the ICSD catalogue of AFLOW. Inclusion in Guo 2022 SI table seen only via search snippet (SI PDF not retrievable). Not proof of absence of TE work.

evidence: Computational TE predictions only (DFT/Boltzmann transport of Bi-based 18-electron half-Heuslers XYBi incl. HfCoBi); no synthesis or measured TE data for pristine HfCoBi found.
notes: Also Singh et al. arXiv:1904.02488 (preprint, computed PF and kappa for CoHfBi; no journal version found). Paul 2024 abstract not retrieved - computational nature inferred from title/theory-unit affiliation. Experimental ZrCoBi-based work (Zhu 2018) does not cover Hf.

evidence: Computational only: first-principles cubic-vs-orthorhombic stability and Boltzmann TE transport for cubic CoNbGe; kappa_L estimate in AFLOW high-throughput screen.
notes: Singh 2019 find the Ge group energetically favours cubic symmetry. No experimental half-Heusler synthesis or TE measurement found.

evidence: Computational only: first-principles phase-stability and Boltzmann TE transport for cubic CoTaGe; kappa_L estimate in high-throughput screen.
notes: No experimental synthesis/TE measurement of half-Heusler TaCoGe found (not proof of absence).

evidence: Computational only: first-principles TE transport for hypothetical cubic CoTaSi, whose reported ground state is orthorhombic; kappa_L estimate in high-throughput screen.
notes: POLYMORPH CAUTION: TaCoSi is reported experimentally in an orthorhombic (TiNiSi-type) structure (Landolt-Bornstein, as cited in a TE patent); the C1b half-Heusler polymorph is not experimentally confirmed. Listed as "CoSiTa" in Carrete Table III.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. Known only computationally: kappa_L estimate in AFLOW high-throughput screen and a DFT optoelectronic/elastic study of CoTiX (X = P, As, Sb); no TE transport study or measurement found.
notes: Listed as "CoAsTi" in Carrete Table III. Not proof of absence.

evidence: Computational TE predictions only (DFT elastic/phonon/Boltzmann TE of ZrCoBi and TiCoBi; Bi-based XYBi screening); no synthesis or measurement found.
notes: Also Singh et al. arXiv:1904.02488 (preprint) and kappa_L in Carrete 2014 ("CoBiTi").

evidence: Computational only: first-principles cubic stability and Boltzmann TE transport for cubic CoVGe; kappa_L estimate in high-throughput screen.
notes: A 2026 arXiv preprint discusses CoVGe magnetotransport (not TE; not verified). No experimental TE data found.

evidence: Computational only: first-principles TE transport for hypothetical cubic CoVSi (ground state reported orthorhombic).
notes: POLYMORPH CAUTION: VCoSi is reported experimentally orthorhombic (Landolt-Bornstein, as cited in a TE patent); not in Carrete list of stable half-Heuslers. Half-Heusler polymorph not experimentally confirmed.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. Known only computationally: kappa_L estimate in high-throughput screen and a DFT elastic/electronic/optical (photovoltaic-oriented) study; TE only mentioned as a possible application.
notes: Listed as "CoAsZr" in Carrete Table III. Not flagged: Kleinke 1998 reports a series MM'As (M = Zr, Hf; M' = Fe, Co, Ni) in which HfCoAs is orthorhombic, but its full text and abstract were not accessible and the structure of ZrCoAs could not be confirmed; no ZrCoAs entry in the ICSD catalogue of AFLOW (queried 12 Oct 2026) and Gautier 2015 lists ZrCoAs as unreported. No TE transport calculation or measurement found.

evidence: Computational only: DFT (FP-LAPW) structural, optoelectronic and TE properties of L2_1 Fe2HfSi under pressure; also in a DFT Fe2YZ band-engineering TE screen.
notes: Fe2HfSi appears in a band-structure figure of Bilc 2015 (checked in arXiv text). No synthesis or measured TE data found.

evidence: Computational only: DFT prediction of large power factor (Fe2YZ band engineering) and DFT lattice-dynamics/TE study of Fe2MAl (M = V, Nb, Ta).
notes: Experiments found only for Nb-substituted Fe2VAl (Fe2V1-xNbxAl), not stoichiometric L2_1 Fe2NbAl.

evidence: Computational only: DFT electronic structure and TE (BoltzTraP) of Fe2TaZ (Z = Al, Ga, In) and Fe2YZ band-engineering TE prediction.
notes: Experiments found only for Ta-substituted Fe2VAl, not stoichiometric Fe2TaAl.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. Computational screening only: kappa_L estimate in AFLOW high-throughput screen and an n-type effective-mass descriptor in a half-Heusler band-engineering table; no dedicated TE study.
notes: Listed as "FeAsNb" in Carrete Table III (checked). Guo 2022 SI inclusion seen only via search snippet. Not proof of absence.

evidence: Computational only: high-throughput DFT (deformation-potential PF, Slack kappa) identifies TaFeAs as a novel stable half-Heusler and the best TE candidate of its set; kappa_L in AFLOW screen.
notes: Listed as "FeAsTa" in Carrete Table III. No synthesis/measurement found.

evidence: Computational only: high-throughput DFT TE (PF/ZT) study names VFeAs among novel stable half-Heuslers with TE potential.
notes: Not in Carrete 2014 stable list. Single computational TE source; a 2025 optoelectronic DFT paper also mentions VFeAs (not verified). No experimental report found.

evidence: Computational only: DFT/BoltzTraP2 power factor and zT (deformation-potential relaxation time, Slack kappa_L) for pristine cubic HH NbIrGe in a high-throughput study; no HH synthesis found.
notes: Polymorph caveat: NbIrGe has been synthesised experimentally only in an orthorhombic Pnma (TiNiSi-type) structure (Mishra 2001, source_2). That does not count as HH evidence. The HH phase may be metastable.

evidence: HH TaIrGe has been synthesised (as a p-type transparent conductor, not a TE study); the TE evidence is computational (DFT/BoltzTraP zT under strain), on pristine material.
source_1: Nisha 2021, Journal of Solid State Chemistry 303, 122524
notes: The compound is experimentally realised in the cubic HH structure (Yan 2015, source_2), but no experimental Seebeck/zT measurement was found. A 2016 Energy Procedia paper on TaIrGe stability is RETRACTED; do not cite it.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. No TE study of cubic HH TaIrSi found; the only literature concerns the orthorhombic polymorph (structure/magnetism, superconductivity).
notes: Polymorph caveat: TaIrSi is known experimentally as orthorhombic Pnma (TiNiSi-type), not as an HH. Its hull distance in our database (0.080 eV/atom) fits with the HH being metastable. A targeted search found nothing, but this does not prove no work exists.

evidence: Computational only: DFT/BoltzTraP TE study of pristine HH TaIrSn reporting large predicted zT; other DFT papers cover its optical/thermodynamic properties.
source_2: Touia 2021, Journal of Superconductivity and Novel Magnetism 34, 2865-2877
notes: No experimental synthesis or TE measurement found. A 2016 Energy Procedia paper that includes TaIrSn is RETRACTED.

evidence: Computational only: first-principles TE study (S, sigma, kappa, zT) of pristine HH TiIrAs and TiIrSb.
source_1: Kaur 2017, Journal of Alloys and Compounds 727, 1171-1177
notes: The study highlights TiIrSb rather than TiIrAs. No experimental work found.

evidence: Computational only: DFT study of structural, vibrational and TE properties of pristine HH VYGe (Y = Rh, Co, Ir); also in a high-throughput PF/zT screen.
notes: No experimental work found.

evidence: Computational only for the HH polymorph: DFT/BoltzTraP zT prediction for pristine HH NiHfGe, plus DFT stability/elastic work (Osafile 2021, Mol. Phys. 119, e1936249, doi 10.1080/00268976.2021.1936249, verified).

evidence: Computational only for the HH polymorph: TB-mBJ DFT study of NiHfZ (Z = Si, Ge) that includes transport/TE quantities; DFT stability study (Osafile 2021).

evidence: Computational only: several DFT+Boltzmann TE studies of pristine HH ScNiAs (NiTZ family; XNiAs X = Sc, Y; Ni-based HH high-throughput).
notes: Also in Chen et al. ACS Omega 6, 18269 (2021), doi 10.1021/acsomega.1c02172 (verified). No experimental synthesis/TE found.

evidence: Computational only: ab initio power-factor and TE studies of p-type ScNiBi (with YNiBi, LuNiBi).
source_2: Missoum 2023, The European Physical Journal B 96, 160
notes: No experimental TE measurement of ScNiBi found (unlike YNiBi).

evidence: Computational only for the HH polymorph: included in DFT/Boltzmann high-throughput TE studies (Ni-based HH; 18-electron HH PF/zT screen).

evidence: Computational only: dedicated DFT TE study of pristine HH TiXPb (X = Ni, Pd, Pt), with low predicted kappa_L.
notes: Stability is disputed: Bilińska & Winiarski (Crystals 2023, doi 10.3390/cryst13091378) place HH TiNiPb within about 50 meV of a Pnma competitor and leave it out. Other high-throughput work finds it off the hull because of TiNi. No experiment found.

evidence: Computational only for the HH polymorph: DFT/Boltzmann TE of pristine HH NiTiSi in a Ni-based HH high-throughput study; also a 2020 conference DFT TE abstract (Bati et al., MDPI IOCC 2020; DOI not verified).
source_2: Downie 2023, Zeitschrift für anorganische und allgemeine Chemie 649, e202300055
notes: Polymorph caveat: TiNiSi is the prototype orthorhombic Pnma structure. Experimental TE (Downie 2023, source_2) is for that phase. The cubic HH is hypothetical (our database hull distance is 0.090 eV/atom).

evidence: Computational only: DFT/Boltzmann TE (PF, zT) of pristine HH NiVGa in Ni-based HH screens.
notes: No experimental work found. Our database hull distance is 0.095 eV/atom.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. No TE study of the cubic HH polymorph found; experimental TE transport exists only for orthorhombic TiNiSi-type ZrNiGe (a semimetal).
notes: Polymorph caveat: the composition is known and its orthorhombic phase was measured (small n-type S; Saurabh 2021, source_1). This should not be read as HH evidence. A targeted search found no HH-specific study, which does not prove none exists.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. No TE study of the cubic HH polymorph found; experimental TE (pristine and Sb/Hf-doped) exists only for orthorhombic TiNiSi-type ZrNiSi.
notes: Polymorph caveat: the orthorhombic ZrNiSi semimetal has measured S about -20 uV/K and peak zT about 0.055 when doped (Saurabh 2022). Not HH evidence. Our database hull distance for the HH is 0.083 eV/atom.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. Predicted thermodynamically stable HH (DFT and CALYPSO structure search) in an inverse-design TE paper whose experimental work covered TaFeSb, not NbOsSb; no TE calculation or measurement of NbOsSb found.
notes: Known only as a computational stability prediction. No synthesis found.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. Predicted thermodynamically stable HH (DFT and CALYPSO structure search) in the TaFeSb discovery paper; no TE calculation or measurement of TaOsSb found.

evidence: Cubic F-43m: computational only, a DFT/deformation-potential TE study of pristine PdMX (M = Sc, Y; X = P, As, Sb) giving kappa_L and zT for PdScAs; also an ML power-factor prediction.

evidence: Computational only: a single PBE-GGA DFT study of pristine PdTiZ (Z = Ge, Pb) including Boltzmann-transport thermoelectric properties.

evidence: Computational only: DFT+Boltzmann prediction of p-type TE performance of pristine TiPdSn, and a hybrid-DFT (CRYSTAL) TE study of TiMSn (M = Ni, Pd, Pt) including defects.

evidence: Computational only: one DFT + Boltzmann-transport study (electronic, phonon, effective mass, ZT) of pristine PdXSn (X = Zr, Hf).

evidence: Computational only: DFT (GGA/mBJ) + Boltzmann transport assessment of pristine PtNbZ (Z = Al, Ga, In) for TE use; a separate hybrid-DFT study covers structure/electronic/optical properties only.
notes: Both studies are 2025; no synthesis or measurement found.

evidence: Computational only: DFT (GGA/mBJ) + Boltzmann transport assessment of pristine PtNbZ (Z = Al, Ga, In); a separate hybrid-DFT study covers structure/electronic/optical properties only.
notes: Both studies are 2025; no synthesis or measurement found.

evidence: Computational only: DFT stability and Boltzmann-transport power-factor study of pristine XTaZ (X = Pd, Pt; Z = Al, Ga, In) half-Heuslers; a separate hybrid-DFT study covers structure/electronic/optics.
notes: No synthesis or measurement found.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. Computational only and not TE: a hybrid-DFT study of PtYZ (Y = V, Nb, Ta; Z = Al, Ga, In) reports structure, stability, electronic and optical properties; no transport/TE calculation or measurement for PtVGa was found.

evidence: Computational only: an ab initio study of pristine MRhSb (M = Ti, Zr, Hf) including BoltzTraP Seebeck/TE properties alongside elastic, thermodynamic and optical properties.
notes: Single computational TE study found; no synthesis or measurement found.

evidence: Computational only: DFT study of electronic, elastic, thermoelectric and optical properties of XRhZ (X = V, Nb; Z = Si, Ge), plus a DFT TE preprint on RhNbZ (Z = Ge, Sn).

evidence: Computational only: Boltzmann transport + deformation-potential + Slack-model TE study of pristine XRhSn (X = V, Nb, Ta), plus a DFT TE preprint on RhNbZ (Z = Ge, Sn).

evidence: Computational only: WIEN2k + BoltzTraP study of pristine RhTaZ (Z = Si, Ge, Sn) concluding high predicted ZT; compound itself listed as previously reported in ICSD.

evidence: Computational only: DFT+Boltzmann assessment of p-type TaRhSn, and a later Boltzmann/deformation-potential study of n-type XRhSn (X = V, Nb, Ta).
notes: Gautier 2015 lists TaRhSn as previously unreported and predicted stable in F-43m; no synthesis or measurement found.

evidence: High-throughput half-Heusler transport/quality-factor screen only. evidence: Computational only: an ab initio study of MRhSb (M = Ti, Zr, Hf) including BoltzTraP Seebeck coefficients; a second DFT study covers structural, mechanical and phonon properties (no TE).

evidence: Computational only: WIEN2k + BoltzTraP TE study of pristine RhVX (X = Si, Ge), and a DFT electronic/elastic/TE/optical study of XRhZ (X = V, Nb; Z = Si, Ge).

evidence: Computational only: DFT + semiclassical Boltzmann study of pristine p-type RuVAs and RuNbAs (Seebeck, conductivity, lattice thermal conductivity, ZT).
